# Hotel Bhavani Boarding & Lodging, Udupi

## Summary
Hotel Bhavani is a budget hotel in Udupi city center, Karnataka, India. Established in 1990. Located at Shyam Complex, Maruthi Veethika, Near Head Post Office, Udupi 576101.

## Location
- 600 meters (5 min walk) from Sri Krishna Temple (Krishna Math)
- 400 meters (5 min walk) from Udupi Bus Stand (KSRTC)
- 6 km (15 min auto) from Malpe Beach and St. Mary's Island boat point
- 5 km from Manipal University
- GPS: 13.3401454, 74.7496898
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fn6qMLiw7N8J1hVw6

## Room Rates (Indian Rupees)
- Single Bedded Room (1 bed): ₹500 per night
- Double Bedded Room (2 beds): ₹700 per night
- Three Bedded Room (3 beds): ₹900 per night

## Key Features
- 24-hour checkout (full 24 hours from check-in time, not fixed 12 PM)
- Check-in: 6 AM to 11 PM
- All rooms include: attached bathroom, fan, light, clean linen
- Payment: Cash and UPI (no advance payment required)
- Booking: Call 0820-2526980 or WhatsApp one day before visit

## Contact
- Phone: 0820-2526980 (6 AM to 10 PM)
- WhatsApp: Available for booking inquiries
- Website: https://www.hotelbhavaniudupi.in/

## Ideal For
- Pilgrims visiting Sri Krishna Temple
- Bus travelers arriving at Udupi Bus Stand
- Tourists visiting Malpe Beach and St. Mary's Island
- Students and families visiting Manipal University
- Budget travelers looking for clean, affordable accommodation

## Address
Hotel Bhavani Boarding & Lodging
Shyam Complex, 1st Floor
Maruthi Veethika, Near Head Post Office
